jobs.title: Desenvolvedor Frontend Sênior
jobs.text: Experiência sólida com React, TypeScript e Next.js. Testes automatizados com Jest e Testing Library. Conhecimento em acessibilidade, performance web e Core Web Vitals. Design system com Storybook. CI/CD e Git. Inglês intermediário é diferencial.

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs.text: 5+ years with React and TypeScript, Next.js, server-side rendering. Strong testing culture: unit tests, Playwright e2e. Accessibility (WCAG). Web performance. Collaborate with product and design in Figma. Fluent English. Experience with AI tools a plus.
